title: Explicit local security modes
description: Make the local control-plane security posture explicit. Add trusted-open mode for externally protected local deployments, preserve API-key compatibility mode, expose non-secret readiness metadata, and keep hosted upstream access disabled in trusted-open mode.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Starting explicit local security modes slice.

Context:
- Production vetting under plx-e5297f is complete and shows local MVP proof passes, but auth/tenancy was previously recorded as a production risk.
- The desired local/K8s deployment model may rely on external access control, such as cluster networking, ingress, VPN, or another perimeter.
- Fully open trusted mode is therefore an intentional supported mode for externally protected deployments, not an accidental demo shortcut.

Implementation intent:
- Add explicit `trusted_open` and `api_key` modes.
- In `trusted_open`, Plexus does not authenticate or authorize callers and does not enforce account tenancy; any reachable caller can access local records.
- Guard `trusted_open` so it only works in local backend mode and never with hosted upstream forwarding enabled.
- Keep API-key mode as compatibility boundary only; it must not be described as tenant isolation.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Explicit local security modes slice implemented.

What changed:
- Added `PLEXUS_PROXY_AUTH_MODE=trusted_open|api_key`.
- `trusted_open` is explicit fully open local mode: no Plexus auth, no account authorization, external access control required.
- `api_key` preserves the existing shared-secret compatibility boundary and is not tenant isolation.
- `/readyz` now reports non-secret security metadata: backend mode, auth mode, whether auth mode was explicit, upstream-disabled state, and whether external access control is required.
- Guardrails reject trusted-open readiness/startup unless backend mode is local and hosted upstream forwarding is disabled.
- Added trusted-open smoke proof and updated production-vetting evidence to distinguish trusted-open from API-key mode.

Verification:
- Targeted proxy tests passed: 34 passed.
- Full clean local proof harness passed in default API-key mode.
- Trusted-open smoke passed: no-key GraphQL read succeeded by design and no hosted upstream requests were recorded.
- Vetting harness passed in API-key mode with auth/tenancy still recorded as tenant-isolation risk.
- Vetting harness passed in trusted-open mode with summary pass=2 risk=4 blocked=0.

Current local smoke proxy was restored to default API-key mode after trusted-open verification.
